title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.3 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 18:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 418 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

There goes a C-Class flare! 💥🌎

A large dark coronal-hole-like region is visible across the southern solar disk; no clear CME is evident.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
